QUIC test sandbox API with packet capture, mock crypto keys, and frame injection helpers.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_quic_sandbox_t` test harness for `fd_quic`. It declares the sandbox object layout, default network and timeout values, and the object lifecycle functions [`fd_quic_sandbox_align`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_align>), [`fd_quic_sandbox_footprint`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_footprint>), [`fd_quic_sandbox_new`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_new>), [`fd_quic_sandbox_init`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_init>), and [`fd_quic_sandbox_delete`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_delete>). The file also exposes fixed cryptographic material and packet capture access helpers, including [`fd_quic_sandbox_next_packet`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_next_packet>) and [`fd_quic_sandbox_packet_data`](<#fd_quic_sandbox_packet_data>). In addition, it declares mock test entrypoints that create an established connection and inject QUIC frames or ping packets directly into the `fd_quic_t` instance.
